verdict.rationale: Delaware's public business-tax-forms page on revenue.delaware.gov, which the probe identifies as the open, unauthenticated surface, lists specific forms such as the BUS-RDC R&D credit application. The FAQs also name forms like the Amended GR Return, the Request for Change form and the Withholding Reconciliation, so forms appear to be published openly, while account sessions gate only portal filing. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that form files (e.g., PDFs) actually download without login, evidence that separate instruction documents are published alongside the forms, and hands-on or independent corroboration of account-free download.
